description: NSW Land Values and Property Sales Map is an interactive resource (dashboard, viewer or map) listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Regional Data Hub group, published by NSW Valuer General. An online interactive map that allows users to view data on property sales and land value information in NSW, using data from the NSW Valuer General. Land value data is available for the last five years. Property sales data is available back to 2001 for individual addresses, and back five years for suburb level data. Coverage is the states and territories, 2001 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2023-10-27. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
